data.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?

result.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?
result.markdown:
For most small online stores in the United States, **I'd recommend Stripe as the best overall payment processor**, with PayPal as an additional checkout option.

However, the best choice depends on what platform your store uses, how much you sell, and how much you want to pay in processing fees.

## Best payment processors for small online stores

![Vagus Nerve Certification | MindMax Academy](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/aXMVm1C0IZ2sYL1Cc-pnLa0-TAY84r1ttAkC3L-BonUW-0ZWt4YgfYxZJFNFO507YDw7sEw0_m36oWUAFe9k5k5U7mabcFJnFcYfX_JEQIwvZxSSTzYlrpiE9fNs0cFfLq2VqBOGktLoGahF64GIPKHvKbJJ1Jz0L_56eTNx-TPu4D5oHHq8-DAX5xxs05i8?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Stripe**

(Best overall)

- Standard online card fee: 2.9% + \$0.30
- No standard monthly processing fee
- Excellent fraud protection and reporting
- Supports subscriptions, digital and physical products

Best for independent online stores, WooCommerce and custom websites.

[Stripe website](https://stripe.com)

---

![Download the PayPal logo in PNG y SVG | LogosDown](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/MAzkiJ1YuDnyj2FyYAyszlEHA_k7S0XqFuDRhbVDc0cICTj1-X82VJgt7N8vcRcKsONlo3HvF0Pe2MUizAJnEXGjXwhkQKSdT9w8dASkeKU2hONBc_K0UGh46cKL9ey1QEsmTJtnMOjwtp9k8flMfotUdye-2o09Vcb_X37Fr_RqbfMx2vNQ-Z2QRLli3zQI?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. PayPal**

(Best for customer trust)

- Fees depend on checkout method
- Familiar payment option for customers
- Supports PayPal and eligible alternative payment methods
- Easy to add to most ecommerce platforms

Best as an additional payment option alongside Stripe.

[PayPal Business](https://www.paypal.com/business)

---

![Shopify Payments w Polsce – jak działa, koszty, wdrożenie, zalety - Adtrip](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/tzlxg0Y9z5dRoMa7puRQ5gUF-G3hcQ7FEcuVco38BEG917LKXepufVl9cw-FwTKDdqoHqkcHNs202c43Bsg-KXxlvnrYPNEJMBSIYJqLREQ2DlgIvAOQgkKyUCOU_zdRd59gIwC2e-5cs0YCLvv_6mYa-9FiK4qFkvvkawoheALPlNv3AkWQkvUMElw-UVk8?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Shopify Payments**

- Basic online card rate: typically 2.9% + \$0.30
- Integrated directly into Shopify
- Simplifies refunds, reporting and payouts
- Avoids additional third-party transaction fees under eligible conditions

Best if your store is built on Shopify.

[Shopify Payments](https://www.shopify.com/payments)

---

![square-logo](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/1usVU99QTc623Z1qK0LnerrVUCFuaCZRY9kzKFoWI_Gdr9NcpX1vWKOmILymiErxn6ndDcZZ0Or5-PjPVYj_lTK1K9NB9Q8Cck3TogeQjE13w7S0OC_soTbxUb84o9oqvCcpbffi8RgWQf3ncfxvUqtopiXbgd9lTiIMfcExXBRU8XgKgcPu-V2QhGDsZYzn?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Square**

- Free starting plan
- Online fees around 3.3% + \$0.30 on its Free plan
- Combines online and in-person sales
- Inventory and sales management tools

Best if you also sell at markets, events or physical locations.

[Square website](https://squareup.com/us/en/payments)

[www.nerdwallet.com](https://www.nerdwallet.com/business/software/learn/stripe-vs-paypal-vs-square?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[zapier.com](https://zapier.com/blog/best-payment-gateways/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.shopify.com](https://www.shopify.com/blog/best-payment-gateways?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## What would I choose?

| Your situation | My recommendation |
|--------|--------|
| Just starting an online store | Stripe |
| Using Shopify | Shopify Payments |
| Want customers to pay with PayPal | Add PayPal |
| Selling online and in person | Square |
| Processing higher monthly sales | Compare Helcim |


One important tip: Don't choose based on transaction fees alone. Also compare chargeback fees, international card fees, payout times, refund policies and account-hold procedures.
